doc: write_products with type, high_share and wind: type = round(clip(a, 0, 1) * 255) as an L PNG, high_share the same x 254 (255 means "none authored" in the engine, so 1.0 maps to 254), wind an RGB PNG through encode_wind (R east, G north, B 0). The inputs are rounding ties, clip edges and infinities (see write_map); wind sits on odd quarters (128 + v / 0.5 is an exact .5). Exact: integers. params.products is the sidecar text.

products.type: gray 8-bit, 0 = stratiform bottom type .. 255 = convective top type (weather map B)
products.high_share: gray 8-bit, share of cloud with tops above 440 hPa, 0..1 x 254 (255 = none)
products.wind: RGB, R east / G north, m/s = (byte - 128) x 0.5, B unused
